entries.title: Jeremiah 37:1
segments: And king Zedekiah the son of Josiah reigned instead of Coniah the son of Jehoiakim, whom Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon made king in the land of Judah.

entries.title: Jeremiah 37:2
segments: But neither he, nor his servants, nor the people of the land, listened to the words of the LORD which He spoke by the prophet Jeremiah.

entries.title: Jeremiah 37:3
segments: And Zedekiah the king sent Jehucal the son of Shelemiah and Zephaniah the son of Maaseiah the priest to the prophet Jeremiah, saying, Pray now to the LORD our God for us.

entries.title: Jeremiah 37:4
segments: And Jeremiah came in and went out among the people, for they had not put him into prison.

entries.title: Jeremiah 37:5
segments: And Pharaoh's army had come out from Egypt. And when the Chaldeans who besieged Jerusalem heard news of them, they departed from Jerusalem.

entries.title: Jeremiah 37:6
segments: And the word of the LORD came to the prophet Jeremiah, saying,

entries.title: Jeremiah 37:7
segments: So says the LORD, the God of Israel: You shall say this to the king of Judah, who sent you to Me to inquire of Me: Behold, Pharaoh's army, which has come forth to help you, shall return to Egypt into their own land.

entries.title: Jeremiah 37:8
segments: And the Chaldeans shall come again and fight against this city, and capture it, and burn it with fire.

entries.title: Jeremiah 37:9
segments: So says the LORD: Do not deceive yourselves, saying, The Chaldeans shall surely depart from us. For they shall not depart.

entries.title: Jeremiah 37:10
segments: For though you had stricken the whole army of the Chaldeans who fight against you, and there remained [only] wounded men among them, they would rise up, each man in his tent, and burn this city with fire.

entries.title: Jeremiah 37:11
segments: And it happened when the army of Chaldeans was made to go up from Jerusalem because of fear of Pharaoh's army,

entries.title: Jeremiah 37:12
segments: then Jeremiah went out of Jerusalem to go into the land of Benjamin, to receive a portion from there in the midst of the people.

entries.title: Jeremiah 37:13
segments: And it happened, he [being] in the gate of Benjamin, a commander of the guard named Irijah [was] there, the son of Shelemiah, the son of Hananiah. And he seized Jeremiah the prophet, saying, You are falling away to the Chaldeans.

entries.title: Jeremiah 37:14
segments: Then Jeremiah said, A lie! I am not falling away to the Chaldeans. But he did not listen to him; so Irijah took Jeremiah and brought him to the rulers.

entries.title: Jeremiah 37:15
segments: And the rulers were angry with Jeremiah, and struck him, and put him in prison, the house of Jonathan the scribe. For they had made that the prison.

entries.title: Jeremiah 37:16
segments: When Jeremiah had entered into the house of the pit, and into the cells, then Jeremiah remained there many days.

entries.title: Jeremiah 37:17
segments: And Zedekiah the king sent and took him out. And the king asked him secretly in his house, and said, Is there [any] word from the LORD? And Jeremiah said, There is. For, He said, you shall be delivered into the hand of the king of Babylon.

entries.title: Jeremiah 37:18
segments: And Jeremiah said to king Zedekiah, What have I offended against you, or against your servants, or against this people, that you have put me in prison?

entries.title: Jeremiah 37:19
segments: Where now [are] your prophets who prophesied to you, saying, The king of Babylon shall not come against you nor against this land?

entries.title: Jeremiah 37:20
segments: And please hear now, O my lord the king; I beg you, let my cry be pleasing to you, so that you cause me not to return to the house of Jonathan the scribe, lest I die there.

entries.title: Jeremiah 37:21
segments: And Zedekiah the king commanded that they should put Jeremiah into the court of the prison, and that they should give him a piece of bread out of the bakers' street daily, until all the bread in the city was gone. So Jeremiah remained in the court of the prison.
